Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for disciplining real estate appraisers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to real estate appraiser employers; amending RCW18.140.160; providing an effective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.140.160 and 2002 c 86 s 239 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In addition to the unprofessional conduct described in RCW18.235.130, the director may take disciplinary action for the followingconduct, acts, or conditions: (1) Failing to meet the minimum qualifications for state((licensure or)) certification or licensure established by or((pursuant to)) under this chapter; (2) Paying money other than the fees provided for by this chapterto any employee of the director or the commission to procure state((licensure or)) certification or licensure under this chapter; (3) Continuing to act as a ((statelicensed or)) statecertifiedreal estate appraiser or statelicensed real estate appraiser when hisor her ((license or)) certificate or license is on an expired status; (4) Violating any provision of this chapter or any lawful rule madeby the director pursuant thereto; p. 1 SB 6506 (5) Issuing an appraisal report on any real property in which theappraiser has an interest unless his or her interest is clearly statedin the appraisal report; and (6) Being affiliated as an ((employee or independent contractorwith a statelicensed or statecertified real estate appraiser when theappraiser's license or certificate has been revoked due to disciplinaryaction)) employer, independent contractor, or supervisory appraiser ofa statecertified real estate appraiser or statelicensed real estateappraiser whose certification or license is currently in a suspended orrevoked status.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJune 1, 2004.
